label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows directly into target variable, which is used in URL construction at line 29. Although isNonPublicAddress() checks the resolved IP, this validation occurs after DNS resolution and does not prevent SSRF via DNS rebinding, CNAME chains, or hosts pointing to internal IPs. The resolved sink value at line 29 is attacker-controlled (target = param from user input).

evidence.note: User input param assigned to target, then used in URL construction without preventing SSRF
